    Is it legal today?

    FDA status checked 7 Nov 2026

    NAD+ is not a peptide at all; clinics sell it as shots and drips without approval. We show prices and checks for the research-use products and do not link to the shops.

    FDA status of the peptides on this page, each with its source.

    PeptideStatusWhat that means
    EpitalonNot approvedHHS said on 30 Oct 2026 it does not intend to act against licensed pharmacies that compound it for one patient on a prescription, under 10 conditions; that is not FDA approval Source, 7 Nov 2026
    MOTS-cNot approvedHHS said on 30 Oct 2026 it does not intend to act against licensed pharmacies that compound it for one patient on a prescription, under 10 conditions; that is not FDA approval Source, 7 Nov 2026
    NAD+Pharmacy-madepharmacies may compound it while the FDA reviews it; no approved product FDA source, 19 Oct 2026FDA listing: "Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide (NAD)"

    Approved means the FDA approved a product containing it for a stated use. Not approved means no approved product exists; buying it for yourself is not a crime in the US, but nobody has checked what is in the vial. All substances
